description: {"time": 1783112252307, "blocks": [{"id": "frsyo07st5", "data": {"text": "Amber Rose (Square Format) presents Dennis Muraguri's celebrity portrait in a composed, self-contained square crop. Originally painted on a Kacose Sacco matatu, the Amber Rose design was one of the most photographed matatus in Nairobi, drawing attention for its glossy, high-detail airbrush portrait that occupied the entire rear panel of the minibus. In this square format, the portrait stands alone as a fine-art object \u2014 freed from the context of the vehicle, it becomes a pure pop-art composition. Muraguri's woodcut carving captures the contour and attitude of the original airbrush work, translating the painterly gradients of the source material into confident black-and-white linework. Kacose Sacco's fleet is known for bold portraiture, and this print represents the pinnacle of that tradition.
